pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Scurvy$() (vitamin C): wounds heal at half speed and you mine slower.$(li)$(thing)Anemia$() (iron): you move slower.$(li)$(thing)Night Blindness$() (vitamin A): darkness closes in.$(li)$(thing)Brittle Bones$() (calcium): falls hurt 50% more.

$(li)$(thing)Protein Deficiency:$() weaker attacks.$(li)$(thing)Low Energy$() (carbohydrate or fat): slower, and you tire faster.$(li)$(thing)Digestive Distress$() (fibre): you get hungry faster.$(li)$(thing)Malnourished:$() an overall poor diet costs two hearts.
Milk does not cure them: only eating the missing nutrient does.
